meta.usage_correction: billed_usd and usage were inflated by a cumulative-usage bug in `vworld run --round`: the backend is created once and `usage_total` accumulates, so this cell recorded A1's tokens as well as its own. Corrected by exact differencing against the A1 cell, which was served first and is unaffected. The episodes are untouched.
